summary: Kootenai County ground site: a cupola cabin built about 1923 and destroyed in 1950; a 2024 Idaho Fire Lookouts post found only footings and a benchmark.

facts.design: 14 x 14 cupola cabin, log (one source says log and frame), with a patrol platform half a mile south
facts.status_note: Cupola cabin destroyed in 1950; a September 2024 Idaho Fire Lookouts post found a benchmark, a location post and patrol platform footings

firelookout.com calls the cabin log and frame; the Forest Lookouts page and Idaho Fire Lookouts call it log. The story reports both

notes_for_editor: Brief status gone and ground kind hold up. Four sources only, and none documents staffing, so no staffing sentence is written. Idaho Fire Lookouts says it cannot fully read the carvings in the cement, so the 1926 platform date is its own reading. Cause of the 1950 destruction is not stated in any source read. A Facebook group post (1936 photo, grandparents at the lookout) appeared in search only and is not used. Access level is omitted because no source says whether the land is open to the public.
